events.name: Fed raises rates 25bp (first hike in cycle)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 0.25-0.50%, beginning the 2022 tightening cycle.

events.name: Fed raises rates 50bp
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 50 basis points to 0.75-1.00%, largest hike since 2000.

events.name: Fed raises rates 75bp (surprise)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 75 basis points to 1.50-1.75%, largest single hike since 1994.

events.name: Fed raises rates 75bp
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 75 basis points to 2.25-2.50%.

events.name: Fed raises rates 75bp (3rd consecutive)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 75 basis points to 3.00-3.25%, dot plot signals higher terminal rate.

events.name: Fed raises rates 75bp
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 75 basis points to 3.75-4.00%.

events.name: Fed raises rates 50bp (slows pace)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 50 basis points to 4.25-4.50%, signaling slower pace ahead.

events.name: Fed raises rates 25bp
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 25 basis points to 4.50-4.75%.

events.name: Fed raises rates 25bp (SVB crisis)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 25 basis points to 4.75-5.00% despite SVB collapse, signaling data dependence.

events.name: Fed pauses rate hikes
events.description: Federal Reserve holds rates at 5.00-5.25%, first pause after 10 consecutive hikes.

events.name: Fed raises rates 25bp (last hike)
events.description: Federal Reserve raises rates by 25 basis points to 5.25-5.50%, widely expected to be the final hike.

events.name: Fed cuts rates 50bp (first cut)
events.description: Federal Reserve cuts rates by 50 basis points to 4.75-5.00%, beginning easing cycle.

events.name: Fed cuts rates 25bp
events.description: Federal Reserve cuts rates by 25 basis points to 4.50-4.75%.

events.name: Trump imposes 25% tariffs on Canada/Mexico
events.description: Executive orders imposing 25% tariffs on Canadian and Mexican imports, 10% on Chinese goods.

events.name: Tariff pause on Mexico/Canada (30 days)
events.description: 30-day pause announced on tariffs against Mexico and Canada after negotiations.

events.name: US-China tariff escalation to 145%
events.description: US raises tariffs on Chinese imports to 145%; China retaliates with 125% on US goods.

events.name: US-China 90-day tariff truce (Geneva)
events.description: 90-day pause: US reduces China tariffs to 30%, China reduces US tariffs to 10%.

events.name: 2024 US Presidential Election
events.description: Donald Trump wins presidential election, Republicans gain Senate majority.

events.name: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
events.description: SVB fails after bank run; triggers regional bank selloff and emergency Fed lending facility.

events.name: COVID-19 market crash
events.description: S&P 500 drops 12% in one day; WHO declares pandemic; circuit breakers triggered.
